judgment.interpretation: Empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR is not a single semantic class. Workspace evidence establishes at least four distinct meanings across different rows: report-only monitoring (permit 'Report' cells and CSV AVG rows without numeric standard units), non-applicable mass-load statistical bases (Q1/N/A columns with numeric limits on sibling concentration rows), pass/fail WET reporting (pass=0;fail=1 unit encoding and comment), and geometric-mean aggregated reporting. The candidate label numeric_limit is not supported: no empty row carries a populated LIMIT_VALUE_STANDARD_UNITS comparison value, and permit text maps the corresponding cells to Report or N/A rather than a recoverable numeric effluent limit. No workspace source defines a uniform field-level rule that classifies all empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR rows for Purpose A comparison.
judgment.remaining_uncertainty: The obligation asks for one classification of empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR, but retained evidence shows heterogeneous semantics that depend on statistical base, DMR_COMMENT_TEXT, unit encoding, and permit-table context. All 57 empty rows share LIMIT_TYPE_CODE=ENF, which conflicts with a blanket report-only reading. Only 3 of 12 permit packages were opened; not every empty-limit row was matched to permit narrative. No ICIS/NPDES codebook in the workspace defines LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR emptiness. FY2025 DMR measurements contain zero rows with empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR, so Purpose A blocking is inferred from permit_limit structure rather than observed measurement joins.

proposal.interpretation: Empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR cannot be resolved to a single world-level semantic class. Evidence supports context-dependent subclasses (report-only monitoring, non-applicable limit column, pass/fail reporting, geometric-mean reporting), but the frozen packet does not establish admissible disambiguation rules complete enough to implement in construction without per-row model judgment.

children.exact_semantic_question: When LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR is empty and DMR_COMMENT_TEXT is blank, does the row correspond to a permit limit-table Report or N/A cell (monitoring/reporting only, not a numeric effluent limit for that statistical base)?
children.resolution_summary: Report-only monitoring or non-numeric permit-table cell; not a numeric limit row for comparison.

children.exact_semantic_question: When LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR is empty, DMR_COMMENT_TEXT contains WHEN DISCHARGING., and LIMIT_VALUE_TYPE_CODE is Q1 or Q2, is the row a non-applicable mass-load limit column rather than a numeric effluent limit?
children.resolution_summary: Non-applicable N/A mass-load column; numeric concentration limits reside on sibling C2/C3 rows.

children.exact_semantic_question: When LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR is empty and DMR_COMMENT_TEXT encodes PASS=0/FAIL=1 (with pass=0;fail=1 unit descriptors), is the row a pass/fail WET reporting obligation rather than an ordinary numeric concentration limit?
children.resolution_summary: Special pass/fail reporting semantics; not report-only monitoring and not an ordinary numeric concentration limit.

children.exact_semantic_question: When LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR is empty and DMR_COMMENT_TEXT requires reporting the geometric mean of weekly values, is the row a report-only or non-numeric statistical-base cell while numeric limits appear on sibling rows?
children.resolution_summary: Report-only/non-numeric cell under geometric-mean reporting instructions; numeric limits appear on sibling AVG/C2 or mass-load rows.

refinement.why_necessary: Retrieved permit text and structured rows show four materially different reasons LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR is empty: permit-table Report/N/A cells, N/A mass-load columns under WHEN DISCHARGING, pass/fail WET encoding, and geometric-mean TDS reporting rows. A single trichotomy (numeric limit vs report-only vs something else) assigns different correct answers to different 57-row subsets, so the parent obligation cannot be resolved uniformly.

mechanically_computable.partition_rule: For permit_limits rows where LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR is empty after trim: if DMR_COMMENT_TEXT matches PASS = 0 and FAIL = 1 (case-insensitive substring) -> empty_limit_wet_pass_fail_encoding; else if DMR_COMMENT_TEXT contains GEOMETRIC MEAN -> empty_limit_geometric_mean_schedule_row; else if DMR_COMMENT_TEXT contains WHEN DISCHARGING. -> empty_limit_when_discharging_mass_column; else -> empty_limit_report_or_na_permit_cell.
